<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-param "<!ENTITY ent-val 'Parameter Expanded'>">
  %ent-param;
  <!ENTITY ent-general "General &ent-val;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Complex root comment with CDATA inside comment: <!-- test --> -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <?sub:pi target="data" processing="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup <child>&ent-general;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent-general;</child>
</root>
```

<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY nested "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY paramEntity 'PE-Data'>">
  %pe;
]>
<?pi-target data="value" test="1"?>
<doc xmlns="http://ns.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://ns.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment 1: Document root start -->
  <section m:id="s1">
    <?m:pi action="parse"?>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with entity reference simulation &nested;
    ]]>
    <m:info>&nested;</m:info>
  </section>
  <section m:id="s2">
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block containing ¶mEntity; and other symbols <>&'"
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "O'Reilly">
  <!ENTITY corp "&pub; Media Inc.">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY spec SYSTEM "spec.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %ext-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="catalog.css" type="text/css"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top-level inventory catalog comment -->
  <book>
    <?catalog-action status="active"?>
    <title>
      <![CDATA[XML & Entity Processing Strategies]]>
    </title>
    <author>&corp;</author>
  </book>
</catalog>

<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <!ENTITY % local.attrs "xmlns:ext CDATA #IMPLIED">
  <!ATTLIST record %local.attrs;>
]>
<?db-setup mode="safe" cache="no"?>
<database xmlns="http://db.org/schema" xmlns:ext="http://db.org/ext">
  <!-- Database containing nested entity chains and mixed content -->
  <record ext:type="primary">
    <?ext-pi execute="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw record contents with <tag> and γ entities inside CDATA.
    ]]>
    γ
  </record>
</database>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE svg [
  <!ELEMENT svg (defs*, g*)>
  <!ELEMENT defs (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT g (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY grid "GridPattern">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-snippet "<!ELEMENT rect EMPTY>">
  %dtd-snippet;
  <!NOTATION svg-notif SYSTEM "image/svg+xml">
  <!ENTITY icon SYSTEM "icon.svg" NDATA svg-notif>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="svg.css"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- SVG container with multiple namespaces and processing instructions -->
  <defs>
    <?svg-debug level="verbose"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <rect id="&grid;" width="100" height="100"/>
    ]]>
  </defs>
  <g xlink:type="simple">
    &grid;
  </g>
</svg>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (settings, logs)>
  <!ELEMENT settings (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT logs (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY default-timeout "30">
  <!ENTITY full-config "Timeout: &default-timeout;s">
  <!ENTITY % remote-ent "<!ENTITY remote 'ExternalData'>">
  %remote-ent;
]>
<?config-processor engine="v2"?>
<config xmlns="http://cfg.org/config" xmlns:env="http://cfg.org/env" xmlns:sys="http://cfg.org/sys">
  <!-- System Configuration Root Comment -->
  <settings env:mode="production">
    <?env-action reload="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Config block <env>development</env> with &remote; reference.
    ]]>
  </settings>
  <logs sys:level="debug">&full-config;</logs>
</config>
```

<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (payload)*>
  <!ELEMENT payload (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY token "TKN-98765">
  <!ENTITY auth-header "Authorization: Bearer &token;">
  <!ENTITY % security-macro "<!ENTITY sec-level 'High'>">
  %security-macro;
  <!NOTATION secure-notif SYSTEM "urn:secure">
  <!ENTITY cert SYSTEM "cert.pem" NDATA secure-notif>
]>
<?api-meta version="1.0" status="stable"?>
<response xmlns="http://api.org/v1" xmlns:sec="http://api.org/sec" xmlns:tr="http://api.org/trace">
  <!-- API Response Wrapper Comment -->
  <payload sec:classification="&sec-level;" tr:id="tr-001">
    <?tr-log level="info" message="processing payload"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Payload payload payload with tokens &auth-header; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
    &auth-header;
  </payload>
</response>
```

  <!ELEMENT workspace (project*)>
  <!ELEMENT project (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY p-name "ProjectAlpha">
  <!ENTITY p-desc "Description for &p-name;">

]>
<?ws-control mode="interactive"?>
<workspace xmlns="http://workspace.org/ns" xmlns:ws="http://workspace.org/ws" xmlns:meta="http://workspace.org/meta">
  <!-- Workspace top-level element with mixed structures -->
  <project meta:owner="Admin" ws:active="&include-flag;">
    <?meta-action validate="strict"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Project CDATA section containing &p-desc; and raw markup <xml/>.
    ]]>
    &p-desc;
  </project>
</workspace>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY id-prefix "ITEM-">
  <!ENTITY item-code "&id-prefix;5542">
  <!ENTITY % attr-macro "<!ATTLIST item stock CDATA #REQUIRED>">
  %attr-macro;
]>
<?inv-control warehouse="west" priority="high"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inv.org/schema" xmlns:loc="http://inv.org/loc" xmlns:stat="http://inv.org/stat">
  <!-- Inventory warehouse items list comment -->
  <item stock="150" loc:aisle="4" stat:status="available">
    <?loc-track scan="complete"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Stock details inside CDATA: code is &item-code;, status is active.
    ]]>
    &item-code;
  </item>
</inventory>
